prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-30):
Fiscal period 2025 Q3 (filed 2025-10-30). Revenue 17,601M, gross margin 83%, operating income 8,386M (operating margin 48%), net income 5,582M, diluted EPS 6.21. Total assets 114,935M, total liabilities 91,085M, shareholders' equity 23,793M. Current assets 62,071M vs current liabilities 40,141M (current ratio 1.55), retained earnings 22,252M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The provided financials reflect exceptional profitability (gross margin 83%, operating margin 48%) and solid liquidity (current ratio 1.55) with positive retained earnings, all consistent with a high-grade non-financial corporate. However, leverage remains material (equity of ~21% of assets, liabilities ~4× equity), which precludes a top-tier AAA assessment.  
DECISION: AA-
